blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Less than a week before Undas, flower prices at Dangwa Market in Manila remain at P450 to P1,500 per bundle, but vendors expect prices to rise by Wednesday, Oct. 28. One vendor told INQUIRER.net that a bundle of local white roses costs P450, while Korean roses are priced at P650. Meanwhile, a bundle of medium-sized anthuriums sells for P850, while orchids are priced at P1,500. Radus is also available for P450 per bundle.
